annotations.title: Compare a launch with the previous runs

description: How the runs of one launch went against the previous run of the same tests: for each test its change (fixed: fails before, passes now; regressed: passed before, fails now; still_failing; still_passing; new: no earlier finished run; unfinished: still working), the counts of each, and the major and minor problems before and now over the tests that ran before. The previous run of a test is its latest finished run in the project before this launch. Call it once the batch has finished, to say what a change to the agent fixed or broke.
